motivation: EXP-140's write saturated at about 4 logits; its direction divides by the norm weights and is 74 times longer than the smallest write with the same effect. The minimum-norm write along e * w * w_f has 74 times the reach.
hypothesis: With the same read-out, the minimum-norm write makes the closing token the most probable at 70% or more of held-out faulty states while at most 1 in 1,000 other states change their most probable token.

config.write: u = alpha g / |g|, g = e * w * w_f
config.gates: held-out ERR flipped to the closing token >= 70%; held-out negatives with a changed top token <= 0.1%

env.device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
